name: Taishou Mebiusline Teito Bibouroku
original_name: 大正メビウスライン 帝都備忘録
source: The FD features the after stories of Hiiragi Kyouichirou and the four other main characters: Misaki, Shigure, Senge Iori, Tatebayashi Kai. In addition, the twins Ise Kaoru and Ise Kahoru also get their own mini-route.
translation: The FD features the after stories of Hiiragi Kyouichirou and the four other main characters: Misaki, Shigure, Senge Iori, Tatebayashi Kai. In addition, the twins Ise Kaoru and Ise Kahoru also get their own mini-route.
